text:
Maya K: FYI — got a page from Acme support at 03:22 claiming we didnt page for replication lag. Looks like inc-bot suppressed it due to a quiet-window rule. Can someone triage?

inc-bot: automation: suppressor matched rule="quiet-window-asia" for route="pagerflow". Reason: schedule_countdown active. event_id=evt-7a1c. Suppression_debug: id=sb-9f3a

Sam W: that's bad. @Oncall-SRE are you still oncall? we need live handoff and customer impact info.

Oncall-SRE: I'm oncall (NYC). I didn’t get any page. Checking logs now.

Liam H: logs pulled — webhook reached ingestion but pager-adapter returned auth error then suppressor kicked in. snippet: 
```
2026-02-11T03:21:59Z INFO  webhook received id=evt-7a1c
2026-02-11T03:22:00Z ERROR pager-adapter auth=401 route=pagerflow detail="token expired"
2026-02-11T03:22:00Z INFO  suppressor matched rule=quiet-window-asia
```

Priya S: that was the suppressor schedule change I pushed yesterday for holiday windows. Did timezone logic mis-evaluate? :thinking_face:

Sam W: @inc-bot can you show the suppressor evaluation trace for evt-7a1c (need rule boundaries + local tz eval)?

inc-bot: trace: applied_rules=[quiet-window-asia], local_tz=UTC+8, rule_start=03:00UTC, rule_end=04:00UTC, event_ts=03:21:59UTC, user_override=false. Note: legacy pagerflow auth fallback only sends manual pages when suppressor=false.

Oncall-SRE: manual page sent now via OpsPager (sendsms). Customer replied "replication caught up" ~10m after manual page. Impact: ~9 minutes delayed alerting, one support ticket opened.

Maya K: who rolled the suppressor change? Priya — can you confirm what cron/tz you used?

Priya S: that was me. I used a cron expression with implicit server TZ — looks like an off-by-one when daylight rules applied. Sorry — rolling a fix now.

Liam H: quick mitigation: set a temporary suppressor override to allow emergency routes for 30m. Example command:
```
/incidentbot suppressor override set rule=quiet-window-asia allow_routes=pagerflow-critical ttl=30m
```

Priya S: doing it... done. inc-bot confirms override applied; event-replay mode enabled for 15m.

Sam W: good. Suggestion: add a monitor that detects the pattern (suppressor matched + pager-adapter auth-fail) and posts to #eng-oncall — that would have caught this without manual triage.

Maya K: agreed. Also we need to log this as customer-impacting. I'll create a runbook item and link it. http://internal/runbooks/suppressor-tz-check

Oncall-SRE: left note on PD incident and assigned to Priya for rollforward.

Priya S: opening PR to normalize cron to explicit TZ and adding unit tests. PR: http://git/repo/PR-432

Sam W: postmortem action items: 1) default suppressor behavior should fail-open on auth errors, 2) add canary checks during suppressor rollouts, 3) create the monitor Sam suggested. I'll draft the retro.

inc-bot: automation note: override applied, maintenance notifications suppressed during override window. :white_check_mark:

Maya K: thanks all. Moving to post-incident tasks: scan other suppressor rules for implicit TZ usages, add play for manual-page fallback when (suppressor==true AND adapter_auth_fail==true).
